reason: The first Neotoma workflow stopped before any API query because the committed CSV raw-byte SHA did not equal the locally generated panel SHA recorded in the receipt. Scientific panel membership and WCVP accepted host IDs were already frozen; accepted_host_names are lookup labels and must not define biological identity.

scientific_identity.logical_row_definition: species + sorted accepted_plant_name_id list; accepted host display names excluded

canonical_host_name_binding.rule: At every external-data execution, resolve each frozen accepted_plant_name_id to its exact WCVP accepted taxon_name. The committed CSV accepted_host_names column is descriptive and cannot override the ID.

authority_change: Only transport/identity verification changes from raw CSV SHA to logical host-ID binding. Panel membership, host breadth, WCVP IDs, occurrence thresholds, LGM window, climate assets, exposure model, genetic model and all decision gates are unchanged.
